name: inotify_rm_watch
description: inotify_rm_watch() removes the watch associated with the watch descriptor wd from the inotify instance associated with the file descriptor fd. Removing a watch causes an IN_IGNORED event to be generated for this watch descriptor.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the inotify instance

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: fd is not a valid file descriptor
The watch descriptor wd is not valid; or fd is not an inotify file descriptor
